articles.summary: DELRAY BEACH, Fla., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - PetMed Express, Inc., dba PetMeds and parent company of PetCareRx (Nasdaq: PETS), today announced a new partnership with Pet Supermarket to offer pet prescription medications, preventatives and health products to pet parents across Pet Supermarket’s retail stores and digital platforms. PetMeds will leverage its pharmacy infrastructure, licensed pharmacists and e-commerce capabilities, including the ability to ship to all 50 states, to provide Pet Supermarket customers with convenient access to trusted medications and health solutions for their animals. Pet Supermarket serves pet parents through approximately 200 retail stores across the Southeast and its e-commerce experience. articles.title: PetMeds Announces Strategic Partnership with Pet Supermarket to Expand Pharmacy Offering Across Retail and Digital Channels
